caller.argument_order: push category; push child; call 0x41000; caller adds 8 to ESP
caller.condition: caller checks WORD child+0x2e == 0x2f after copying child.y to child+0xd8 and parent+0xdc/+0xe0 to child+0xdc/+0xe0

accesses.effect: if nonzero, zero-extend then shift left 16 and DWORD-store child+4
WORD-store child+0x2a; if table value is zero, store one
`jb 0x41049` skips the next store when value < 8; values >= 8 become 0x10
0x10 selects frame 14; otherwise low-two-bit jump table maps 0/1 to frame 0, 2 to frame 1, 3 to frame 2

native_contract.scope: Function semantics only. The candidate stops before category >= 18 would read beyond the measured 18-row classifier owner; this is a source bound, not a native index clamp or capacity claim.

contract: cdecl void(Actor*,DWORD category). Live row column3 optionally sets y high WORD; live column2 sets state, zero becomes1, unsigned values>=8 become16. State16 selects14; otherwise low bits0/1 select0,2 selects1,3 selects2. Existing guarded frame selector reused.
scope: Nine native comparisons /99 checks using actual source select_frame and existing 216-byte classifier owner. Full Actor bytes and expected y/frame outcomes compared; loaded native and source row mutations restored.
limits: Only finite synthetic rows/categories0..8 and a valid unregistered16-slot frame array tested; no arbitrary alias or full gameplay equivalence.
Category>=18 and unsupported registered frame reads report and terminate before reading outside measured source owners.

discrepancies: Incorrect low-two-bit jump mapping at41094; native states0/1 select frame0.
